# browser-demo

Static page for testing Codio remote browser sessions (guide Browser tab, `codio-tools browser push/pull`).

Page: https://iyashtykov.github.io/browser-demo/

It takes a CSV with `name,score` rows, marks each row `passed` (score >= 70) and offers the report for download as `report-<input name>.csv` (`data.csv` → `report-data.csv`). No sign-in, no server: everything runs in the page.

The Codio assignment that uses it: [iyashtykov/codio-browser-push-pull](https://github.com/iyashtykov/codio-browser-push-pull).

Report format:

```
# generated by browser-demo from data.csv
name,score,passed
alice,82,yes
bob,67,no
carol,91,yes
dave,74,yes
TOTAL,314,3
```
